```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(yaml)
library(htmltools)
library(jsonlite)

# Get language parameter
lang <- params$lang

# Load CV data for selected language
cv_data <- read_yaml(paste0("cv-data-", lang, ".yml"))

# Load translations
translations <- read_yaml("translations.yml")
tr <- translations[[lang]]

# Null coalescing helper
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a) && length(a) > 0) a else b
```

## <img src="images/skills.png" class="section-icon"> `r tr$skills`

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
for (skill in cv_data$skills) {
  cat('<div class="software-item">')
  cat('<span class="software-name">', skill$nombre, '</span>')
  cat('<div class="level-dots">')
  for (i in 1:5) {
    if (i <= skill$nivel) {
      cat('<div class="dot"></div>')
    } else {
      cat('<div class="dot empty"></div>')
    }
  }
  cat('</div>')
  cat('</div>')
}
```

## <img src="images/experience.png" class="section-icon"> `r tr$experience`

::: {.experience-timeline}
```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a) && length(a) > 0) a else b

for (i in seq_along(cv_data$experiencia)) {
  exp <- cv_data$experiencia[[i]]
  
  # Detectar si tiene detalle para mostrar indicador visual
  has_detail <- !is.null(exp$descripcion) && nchar(trimws(as.character(exp$descripcion))) > 0
  
  # Serializar datos del modal como JSON en atributo data-exp
  # gsub escapa las comillas para que sea HTML-attribute safe;
  # getAttribute() en JS las descodifica automáticamente antes de JSON.parse
  exp_data <- list(
    cargo             = as.character(exp$cargo             %||% ""),
    empresa           = as.character(exp$empresa           %||% ""),
    fecha             = as.character(exp$fecha             %||% ""),
    descripcion       = as.character(exp$descripcion       %||% ""),
    responsabilidades = as.list(exp$responsabilidades      %||% list()),
    logros            = as.list(exp$logros                 %||% list()),
    tecnologias       = as.list(exp$tecnologias            %||% list())
  )
  json_str  <- jsonlite::toJSON(exp_data, auto_unbox = TRUE)
  json_attr <- gsub('"', '&quot;', json_str, fixed = TRUE)
  
  cat(paste0('<div class="experience-item experience-clickable"',
             ' data-exp-idx="', i - 1, '"',
             ' data-exp="', json_attr, '">'))
  cat(paste0('<div class="experience-date">', exp$fecha, '</div>'))
  cat('<div class="experience-content">')
  cat(paste0('<div class="experience-title">', exp$cargo, '</div>'))
  cat(paste0('<div class="experience-company">', exp$empresa, '</div>'))
  if (has_detail) {
    cat('<div class="exp-more-hint">&#43; info</div>')
  }
  cat('</div></div>')
}

# Etiquetas traducidas para el modal (objeto pequeño, sin caracteres problemáticos)
cat(paste0(
  '<script>',
  'window.expLabels={',
  'description:"',     tr$modal_description,     '",',
  'responsibilities:"',tr$modal_responsibilities, '",',
  'achievements:"',    tr$modal_achievements,     '",',
  'technologies:"',    tr$modal_technologies,     '"',
  '};',
  '</script>'
))
```

     MODAL DE DETALLE DE EXPERIENCIA
     Se abre al hacer clic en una tarjeta de experiencia
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<div id="exp-modal-overlay" class="modal-overlay">
  <div class="modal-box" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">

    <!-- Header navy con cargo, empresa, fecha -->
    <div class="modal-header">
      <button class="modal-close" id="modal-close-btn" aria-label="Cerrar">&#215;</button>
      <div id="modal-cargo"   class="modal-cargo"></div>
      <div id="modal-empresa" class="modal-empresa"></div>
      <div id="modal-fecha"   class="modal-fecha"></div>
    </div>

    <!-- Cuerpo scrollable con las secciones -->
    <div class="modal-body">

      <div id="modal-desc-section" class="modal-section">
        <div class="modal-section-label" id="modal-label-desc"></div>
        <div id="modal-descripcion" class="modal-description"></div>
      </div>

      <div id="modal-resp-section" class="modal-section">
        <div class="modal-section-label" id="modal-label-resp"></div>
        <ul id="modal-responsabilidades" class="modal-list modal-list-resp"></ul>
      </div>

      <div id="modal-logros-section" class="modal-section">
        <div class="modal-section-label" id="modal-label-logros"></div>
        <ul id="modal-logros" class="modal-list modal-list-logros"></ul>
      </div>

      <div id="modal-tech-section" class="modal-section">
        <div class="modal-section-label" id="modal-label-tech"></div>
        <div id="modal-tecnologias" class="modal-tags"></div>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>
</div>
